bio: Christina Bohannan (born July 2, 1971) is an American politician and law professor who is the representative-elect for Iowa's 1st congressional district in the United States House of Representatives. A member of the Democratic Party, she served from 2021 to 2023 as the Iowa state representative for the 85th House district, being elected in 2020, succeeding Vicki Lensing.
